reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. The original instruction asked for the fourth chapter but also supplied "CUDA core design", which uniquely matches the visible CUDA Core Design chapter title and allows text matching without counting chapter positions. Removed the CUDA core design clause from instruction.en and instruction.zh so that both now request the fourth chapter of the GPU technology video without revealing its title. Updated category.reason to state that the target must be identified by its ordinal position in the visible list. The target remains the same fourth chapter, so the Relative Position category and groundTruth were retained.
